properties.name: Black River Area Development (BRAD) Public Transit
properties.units: Pocahontas city; Walnut Ridge city; Hoxie city; Piggott city; Corning city; Clay County; Lawrence County; Randolph County
properties.note: City routes serve Pocahontas, Walnut Ridge, Hoxie, Piggott, and Corning; county routes extend service into Clay, Lawrence, and Randolph counties (with incidental stops in Greene and Craighead counties, not mapped). https://bradcorp.org/services/transportation/

properties.name: METRO Connect
properties.units: Little Rock city; North Little Rock city; Sherwood city; Conway city
properties.note: Service comprises multiple named zones (John Barrow Road, Riverdale, Levy-Amboy, East Little Rock, Hensley in Little Rock; separate zones in North Little Rock, Sherwood, and Conway). Zone boundaries not precisely specified; approximated by city extent.

properties.name: ORT On-Demand
properties.units: Fayetteville city; Springdale city; Rogers city; Bentonville city
properties.note: On-demand zones within and around four NWA cities. Rogers/Fayetteville/Springdale have full service (Mon-Sat); Bentonville Sat only.
